own_scenes.desc: Antes del beat, el estilo de los grupos femeninos dominó las listas americanas desde que las Shirelles llegaron al número 1 con «Will You Love Me Tomorrow» (1961): discos afilados, bailables y bien observados. «My Boyfriend’s Back» de las Angels y «You Don’t Own Me» de Lesley Gore eran declaraciones chocantes. Tras la invasión británica, los Shangri-Las de Red Bird lo prolongaron un par de años: chicas duras de Queens a las que George «Shadow» Morton dejaba ser ellas mismas en sinfonías de 45 rpm con gaviotas y motos, sobre romances condenados y tragedias familiares, «como la chica corriente». Su último single en Red Bird, «Past, Present and Future» (mayo de 1966), sobre la «Sonata Claro de luna», es un examen desolado de un desastre amoroso.

refs.q: In the years immediately before the beat boom, the girl group style had dominated the American charts.
refs.para: In the years immediately before the beat boom, the girl group style had dominated the American charts. After the Shirelles hit #1 with ‘Will You Still Love Me Tomorrow’ in early 1961, a stream of female groups followed them into the charts. At their best – the Shirelles’ ‘Boys’, the Cookies’ ‘He’s So Fine’ and ‘My Boyfriend’s Back’ by the Angels – they were the top records of their era: sharp, danceable, well-observed expressions of youth and vitality.
refs.chapter: Mayo: Walkin’ My Cat Named Dog: la mística de la feminidad y la independencia femenina

refs.q: These were 45 rpm pop symphonies, hormone-enhanced slices of melodrama that were method-acted out on stage.
refs.para: These were 45 rpm pop symphonies, hormone-enhanced slices of melodrama that were method-acted out on stage. The Searchers’ Chris Curtis saw the Shangri-Las in their pomp and commented on their ‘weird presentation’: ‘The lead singer stands right over on one side of the stage while the other three stand in the middle. When they sing “remember” she sings “walkin’ in the sand”, then turns her head away and looks away despondently. They wave their arms around and do all sorts of weird actions.’
refs.chapter: Mayo: Walkin’ My Cat Named Dog: la mística de la feminidad y la independencia femenina

refs.q: In May 1966, the Shangri-Las released their final single on Red Bird.
refs.para: In May 1966, the Shangri-Las released their final single on Red Bird. Set to the strains of Beethoven’s ‘Moonlight Sonata’, ‘Past, Present and Future’ is a bleak examination of the long-term damage done by a disastrous love affair. The piano-led melody moves up and down the scales and goes precisely nowhere, just as the narrator is stuck in psychological shut-down. ‘At the moment it doesn’t look good,’ Mary Weiss sings, ‘at the moment it will never happen again.’
